responsibility: This file contains the whole-program partitioning logic that splits merged LTO symbol graphs into LTRANS partitions. It builds and manages ltrans_partition objects and their symtab encoders, walks callgraph/reference relationships to place functions, variables, clones, aliases, and constant initializers into partitions, computes partition boundaries, and promotes or renames statics as needed so cross-partition references and symbol visibility remain valid for later streaming and local transformation.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual partition-construction and static-promotion algorithms—building ltrans partitions, assigning symbols, computing boundaries, and renaming/promoting statics—whereas gcc/lto/lto-partition.h only defines the partition data structure and publishes the partitioning APIs.
